purpose: MC-Industry rollout: the menu of Mission Control features an organization can switch on for a trial or hosted deployment. Drives Settings > Features (settings.html).

tiers.advanced: Included in the Enterprise package or as an add-on
tiers.exos: Exos-specific; not offered to outside organizations without rework

status_legend.live: Running in production at Exos today
status_legend.beta: Working at Exos, needs generalization before an outside org uses it
status_legend.exos_only: Built around Exos programs/data; template only

items.name: Jobs & Tasks
items.desc: Prioritized task board with owners, due dates, subtasks, documents tab and version-controlled attachments. Notes and questions answered in-thread by the AI agent.

items.name: Decisions queue
items.desc: One-click approve / hold / drop cards for the executive. Answers flow back to the task and trigger the next action automatically.

items.name: My Dashboard
items.desc: Per-user view of assigned work, deadlines and items needing attention.

items.name: Follow-ups
items.desc: Dated follow-up reminders tied to contacts and tasks, so nothing sent goes unanswered.

items.name: Global search
items.desc: Search across tasks, contacts, companies and documents.

items.name: Schedule & Gantt
items.desc: Program schedule with dependencies, critical path and slack.

items.name: CRM & Contacts
items.desc: Companies, contacts, deals and activity history; email capture links correspondence to records automatically.

items.name: Opportunities pipeline
items.desc: Ranked pipeline of bids, grants and deals by value and deadline, with go/no-go gates.

items.name: Relationship dossiers
items.desc: One-page briefs on people and organizations before a meeting.

items.name: Consortium / teaming
items.desc: Track partners, scopes and backups for multi-party bids.

items.name: Sales commissions
items.desc: Commission tracking per rep and deal.

items.name: Customer orders
items.desc: Quote, order, terms and close-out workflow for customer orders (built for Exos payloads; template for others).

items.name: ExoSign e-signature
items.desc: Native e-signature: send, sign, audit certificate, signed copy filed to the task.

items.name: Data room
items.desc: Permissioned due-diligence data room with readiness scoring and reviewer roles.

items.name: Procedures library
items.desc: Controlled procedures with master list, revision history and approver sign-off.

items.name: Required reading
items.desc: Assign policies to staff and track acknowledgment.

items.name: Vault
items.desc: Encrypted storage for shared and personal credentials and sensitive records.

items.name: Operational finance
items.desc: Cash, AR/AP and funding views fed from the accounting system (role-gated).

items.name: Expense reports
items.desc: Submit, approve and export expense reports.

items.name: Job costing
items.desc: Labor and material cost rolled up per job or contract.

items.name: Suppliers & POs
items.desc: Supplier records, due diligence and purchase orders synced to accounting.

items.name: Asset register
items.desc: Equipment and asset tracking.

items.name: MRP
items.desc: Material requirements planning from the bill of materials.

items.name: Production control
items.desc: Work orders and build status on the shop floor.

items.name: Receiving & inventory
items.desc: Receive against POs, shop inventory with photos, shortfall tracking.

items.name: HR directory
items.desc: Read-only staff directory and org chart mirrored from the HR system.

items.name: Team performance
items.desc: Throughput and on-time metrics per person and team.

items.name: Compliance screening
items.desc: Denied-party screening of every new contact and supplier against the U.S. Consolidated Screening List.

items.name: Ethics & whistleblower report
items.desc: Confidential reporting channel per the employee handbook.

items.name: Gov / DIB readiness
items.desc: Readiness tracker for government contracting (registrations, CMMC, cyber controls).

items.name: Exobot AI agent
items.desc: Persistent AI assistant inside MC: answers in-task questions, drafts documents and email, does research, files results back to the task.

items.name: Agent fleet & governance
items.desc: Registry of every automated agent with a named human owner, eval suite, autonomy limits and audit trail (ExO3 model).

items.name: Research & intel
items.desc: Sourced research briefs and market/industry watch feeds.

items.name: Capability-gap ledger
items.desc: Gaps between what the organization needs to win and what it has, with owners and closure plans.

items.name: Private / local AI models
items.desc: Run sensitive workloads on on-premise open-weight models so data never leaves the tenant.

items.name: Users, roles & SSO-ready login
items.desc: Role-based access (admin, manager, member, external/partner, board) with per-page permissions.

items.name: Partner / board portals
items.desc: Scoped read-only views for partners, directors or customers.

items.name: Backup & recycle bin
items.desc: Nightly backups; every delete is recoverable for 90 days.

items.name: MC Guard security
items.desc: Request filtering, rate limiting and audit logging in front of every page.

items.name: QuickBooks Online
items.desc: Invoices, bills, POs, deposits and journal entries; finance dashboards read live balances.

items.name: BambooHR
items.desc: Directory, org chart, new-hire onboarding triggers, loaded labor rates for job costing.

items.name: Proton Mail
items.desc: Inbound email becomes CRM activity or tasks; outbound drafts and sends from the user's mailbox.

items.name: Microsoft 365 (incl. GCC High)
items.desc: Mail, calendar, SharePoint documents and tenant security (government-cloud capable).

items.name: Discord
items.desc: Decisions feed, task notifications and chat with the AI agent from team channels.

items.name: Teamwork.com
items.desc: Two-way task sync for teams that keep Teamwork as their project tool.

items.name: DocuSign
items.desc: Send envelopes through DocuSign where a counterparty requires it; ExoSign is the native default.

items.name: Peony data room
items.desc: Push data-room documents to an external Peony room for investors.

items.name: SAM.gov
items.desc: Federal opportunity search and fit triage into the pipeline.

items.name: Consolidated Screening List (trade.gov)
items.desc: Denied-party screening behind the Compliance Screening module.

items.name: Anthropic Claude
items.desc: Primary model for the AI agent.

items.name: Additional model providers (xAI Grok, Google Gemini, Moonshot Kimi)
items.desc: Second-opinion reviewers and specialist tiers routed by task.

items.name: Ollama (local models)
items.desc: On-premise open-weight models for private workloads.

items.name: Web research (Tavily)
items.desc: Sourced web search and page extraction for research briefs.

items.name: Supabase (Postgres)
items.desc: System of record for tasks, CRM and activity.

items.name: Cloudflare Zero Trust
items.desc: Identity-aware access and encrypted tunnel; no open inbound ports.

items.name: Duet 3D printer control
items.desc: Shop-floor printer status (Exos example of machine integration).
